controls.assertions: Original AgentRejected/message and original caller rollback policy; no native-loss record; direct no-transaction effects are not secretly rolled back by the new owner.

controls.setup: Inject allocation failure before any SQL/handoff, then separately after original SQL return before controller ACK construction.
controls.assertions: Safe refusal preserves original MemoryError with no effect/loss; completed observed outcome is retained and not replayable even when packet allocation fails.
controls.evidence: Actual final-argument cutpoint, original object identity, full registry and source pins.

controls.title: temporary and detached receiver lifetime
controls.setup: Original side first: temporary Store, detached execute callable/cursor/fetch callable and actual callback resources; healthy and lost-ACK paths.
controls.assertions: Healthy owner cannot retain ordinary fake/unregistered receivers beyond original release; a dead Store is never resurrected. Loss guard only for actual live registered generation.
controls.evidence: Canonical weakrefs/deletion/active-exception traces; explicit GC phase only where original fixture declares.

controls.title: preparation GC reentry and swallowed loss
controls.setup: During actual pre-effect reservation, a finalizer performs another selected child entry that genuinely loses ACK and catches/replaces visible exception.
controls.assertions: Final post-reservation check prevents the new SQL/native entry; classification, caught_expected and no escaped unraisable explicitly asserted.
controls.evidence: Actual child entry saved-then-fault, independent callback_error list, forbidden-provider call counter remains zero.

controls.title: swallowed/replaced native failure
controls.setup: Within a real native or snapshot callback, an actual selected child loses delivery; callback returns or raises another ordinary error.
controls.assertions: Actual active parent remains sticky; no later SQL or successful controller ACK. Ordinary same-named errors with no loss remain ordinary.
controls.evidence: Original callback invocation identity, actual ancestry PID/thread, exact top-level error chain.

controls.title: Context, thread, fork, stale activation
controls.setup: Healthy paused ownership/callback scopes, copied Context, foreign thread and fork; inherited unknown resource versus healthy fresh resource.
controls.assertions: No synthetic ancestry from a stale/copy scope; original creator checks preserved. Resource loss on exact lifetime remains visible without arbitrary new input limits.
controls.evidence: Own children supervised/reaped; process identity; real calls before/after; no broad thread ban.

controls.setup: Saved actual full controller receipt confirms, then resource retirement/finalizer raises MemoryError.
controls.assertions: No retrospective native loss; original foreign error identity preserved; remaining confirmed observations mechanically recover without provider replay; no permanent healthy strong hold.
controls.evidence: Registry and weakrefs at ACK, before next port, after explicit consumer/GC; terminal confirmation actual.

controls.setup: One real installed release bundle with exact controller+decision images and registered current sources; original ordinary and admin caller scopes remain unchanged.
controls.assertions: Whole selected 15-method control owner executes with all retained methods poisoned; exact source/image/child-manifest drift refuses; empty/absent/lazy routes preserved outside declared release.
